default.title: POS accounting controls and daily alert hardening
default.summary: Expand QuickBooks product setup, preserve Toast accounting mappings, and send at most one combined posting-failure email per eligible recipient, POS location, and business date.
features: QuickBooks product and service drafts expose the supported accounting, tax, inventory, purchasing, sales, and classification fields
Toast-to-QuickBooks mappings remain bound to their exact source and QuickBooks company instead of being forgotten between reviews
Sales Receipt and Journal Entry posting failures for one POS location and business date are combined into one actionable email
fixes: Repeated checks, changed blockers, and same-day recurrence cannot create a second email slot for the same eligible recipient and POS location
Resolved, externally posted, cancelled, or unauthorized deliveries are suppressed immediately before send
Provider failures and ambiguous send outcomes are terminal and are not retried
Posting state changes and notification delivery are serialized so stale failures cannot be emailed after recovery
Runtime health requires the daily alert delivery-fence migration
